_comment: Shot list for episode 6. 14 new paintings (prompts below, generated in this order), plus shared stills: the scroll, the pew, Brian's Navy photograph, the series map (maps/ep06.png), the Nazareth synagogue and the lamp at the window from the site paintings, and one still from each earlier episode for the look back. The title and close cards have their lettering added afterwards (title_card.jpg, close_card.jpg).
style: Painterly oil-sketch look, visible brushwork. The fortress of Machaerus on its ridge east of the Dead Sea, a rock-cut cell lit only by a low lamp or the light under a door, and the green country of Galilee. No faces shown close up; figures seen from behind or at a distance. No text in the image. No modern objects. Calm and hopeful, never frightening. 16:9.

shots.prompt: A small cell cut out of solid rock, almost dark. A man in a rough camel-hair cloak sits on straw with his back against the wall, seen from behind and to one side, his head tilted as if listening. The only light is a warm line under a heavy wooden door. Calm, not frightening.
shots.description: A small cell cut out of solid rock, almost dark. A man in a rough cloak sits on straw, seen from behind, his head tilted as if listening. The only light is a line under a heavy door.

shots.prompt: A close view of a rough rock floor in a dim underground cell: a single drop of water falling into a small shallow pool, rings spreading on the water, a little straw nearby, soft warm light from one side. No people.
shots.description: A drop of water falls into a small pool on the rock floor of the cell, rings spreading, a little straw nearby.

shots.at_phrase: From far above, through all that rock
shots.description: The fortress high on its ridge, a palace at the top, the Dead Sea far below.

shots.prompt: A narrow passage cut through rock, lit by one torch in a bracket. On the left a heavy wooden door with an iron bolt and a large lock. A guard in a plain tunic walks away down the passage, seen from behind and small. Warm torchlight on stone.
shots.description: A narrow rock-cut passage lit by one torch. A heavy wooden door with an iron bolt, and a guard walking away down the passage, seen from behind.

shots.at_phrase: And it is the news that troubles him
shots.description: The man in the dark cell again, listening.

shots.prompt: Two men with walking staffs and small packs walk north along a dusty road in the Jordan valley, seen from behind, the river and its green banks to one side and bare hills beyond, morning light, a long road ahead of them.
shots.description: Two men with staffs and small packs walk north along a dusty road in the Jordan valley, seen from behind, a long road ahead.

shots.card:
Not By Sight
Episode 6: The answer to John
shots.prompt: Title card background only: the fortress of Machaerus on a high bare ridge at dusk, seen from a distance, the Dead Sea a long way below and behind it, first stars, no people, no text, keep the lower third calm.
shots.description: Title card over the fortress of Machaerus on its ridge at dusk: Not By Sight, episode six, the answer to John.

shots.prompt: A man in a rough camel-hair cloak stands waist-deep in the Jordan river with one arm raised toward a crowd gathered on the bank, seen from behind and at a distance, reeds and tamarisk along the water, bright open daylight.
shots.description: A man in a rough cloak stands waist-deep in the Jordan with one arm raised toward a crowd on the bank, seen from behind and at a distance.

shots.prompt: The fortress of Machaerus in daylight: a walled stronghold with a palace on the flat top of a steep, bare, cone-shaped hill with sheer cliffs, the Dead Sea far below in the distance, heat haze, no people close up.
shots.description: The fortress of Machaerus in daylight: a walled stronghold with a palace on top of a steep bare hill with sheer cliffs, the Dead Sea far below.

The series map. Machaerus is marked in gold, east of the Dead Sea. Jericho is at eleven o'clock and Jerusalem at ten, about two days' walk round the north end of the sea. Straight ahead at twelve o'clock is Galilee: Nazareth, Capernaum and Bethsaida are all about four days' walk.

shots.at_phrase: From that place he sends his question
shots.description: The two men on the road north again.
The open scroll in warm light. The Scripture reader begins.
The man in the cell again, as the narrator weighs why he asked.

shots.card: So they would see for themselves
shots.description: The two friends on the road again.

shots.prompt: A crowd on a green hillside in Galilee. At its centre a figure in a plain robe, seen from behind, reaches out to an old man who is being steadied by a friend. At the near edge of the crowd two dusty travellers with staffs stand watching, seen from behind. Bright clear light.
shots.description: A crowd on a green hillside in Galilee. A figure in a plain robe, seen from behind, reaches out to an old man steadied by a friend, while two dusty travellers watch from the edge.
The open scroll. The prophet Isaiah.
Inside the small synagogue at Nazareth, a figure seen from behind stands holding an open scroll, the villagers leaning forward to listen.
The open scroll again.

shots.card: Go and tell John what you see
shots.description: The crowd in Galilee again, the two travellers watching.

shots.prompt: Evening. Two tired men with staffs climb a steep rocky path toward the gate of a fortress high above them on a bare ridge, seen from behind, long shadows, the Dead Sea far below catching the last light.
shots.description: An imagined scene. Two tired men climb a steep rocky path toward the gate of the fortress high above them, seen from behind, the Dead Sea far below.

shots.prompt: Inside a rock-cut cell lit by one small oil lamp on the floor. A man in a rough cloak sits on straw, seen from behind, and two travellers crouch in front of him, leaning in to speak, their faces lost in shadow. Warm lamplight on the rock walls.
shots.description: Inside the cell, lit by one small lamp. The prisoner sits on straw, seen from behind, and two travellers crouch before him, leaning in to speak.
The crowd in Galilee again.

shots.card: He kept looking at his own hands
shots.prompt: An old man with white hair, seen from behind and over his shoulder, holds up his two open hands in front of him and looks at them in bright daylight. A friend's hand rests on his arm. A crowd is a soft blur beyond. His face is not shown.
shots.description: An old man, seen from behind, holds up his two open hands and looks at them in bright daylight, a friend's hand on his arm.

shots.card: The eyes of the blind will be opened
shots.description: The lamplit cell again, the prisoner listening.

shots.prompt: The heavy wooden door of the cell seen from the passage outside, shut, its iron bolt across, a thin line of warm lamplight showing underneath it. The passage is empty and quiet. One torch burning low.
shots.description: The heavy door of the cell seen from the passage, shut and bolted, a thin line of lamplight showing beneath it.
A photograph treated to match the paintings: Brian as a young sailor in Navy whites, with Patti beside him. A small plate beneath him reads Mister Scaredy Cat.
The white cane leaning against a church pew. Brian speaks.
The fortress on its ridge again.
The open scroll. Matthew's account, and what Jesus said about John.

shots.prompt: A figure in a plain robe, seen from behind, stands speaking to a large crowd seated on a hillside in Galilee. Far off down the road behind the crowd, two small figures with staffs are walking away toward the south. Clear afternoon light.
shots.description: A figure in a plain robe, seen from behind, speaks to a crowd on a hillside, while far off two small figures with staffs walk away down the road.
The white cane and the pew. Brian speaks.
Looking back. Episode one: a man kneels at the edge of the Pool of Siloam.
Episode two: the crowd on the Jericho road stands still.
Episode three: a man looks out at the whole lake in clear light.

shots.at_phrase: Two men who followed by sound
shots.description: Episode four: two men follow a crowd down a lane, one with a hand on the other's shoulder.

shots.at_phrase: Crowds on a mountain and in the Temple.
shots.description: Episode five: the glad crowd on the crest of the hill.
And this episode: the crowd in Galilee, at the hour the answer was given.
The white cane and the pew. Brian's closing thoughts.

shots.at_phrase: I know that someday I will see again.
shots.description: A single clay lamp burning on a window ledge, the first line of dawn along the horizon beyond.

shots.at_phrase: They say blindness is the second greatest fear
shots.description: The white cane and the pew again.

shots.card:
For we walk by faith, not by sight.
2 Corinthians 5:7

blindnessinthebible.com
shots.prompt: Closing card background only: dawn over the Dead Sea seen from a high bare ridge, the water turning gold, hills on the far side, a wide clear sky, no people, no text, keep the upper half calm.
shots.description: Closing card over the Dead Sea at dawn: For we walk by faith, not by sight, and the address blindnessinthebible.com.
